en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong launches Halloween Monster Mash events through end of October
en.dek: The district’s annual celebrations begin on 14 October with themed food, evening DJ sets and a short monster street performance on selected nights.
body: Lan Kwai Fong has begun its Halloween programme, running from 14 to 31 October under the banner of a citywide cosplay celebration.

According to the Lan Kwai Fong Association, restaurants in the area are offering themed menus and promotions throughout the period. On designated evenings from 7pm to 11pm, a DJ will perform at The Plaza and a face-painting station will operate at No. 1 Lan Kwai Fong. Between 8pm and 8.30pm on those nights a monster troupe is scheduled to move through the streets with a short parade and performance.

The programme coincides with the Hong Kong Tourism Board’s broader Halloween Month activities across several districts. Organisers said visitors can dress in costume and take part in the street events. Details and any collection of promotional cards are listed on the association’s website.
The events are free to enter the public streets; individual restaurants set their own prices for food and drink.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊萬聖節怪物巡禮夜由今日起至月底舉行
zh.dek: 區內餐廳推出主題餐飲，指定晚上有DJ打碟及怪物軍團於晚上8時至8時半快閃街道表演。
body: 蘭桂坊由10月14日至31日展開萬聖節活動，以全城cosplay慶祝為主題。
蘭桂坊協會表示，區內食肆在活動期間推出主題美食及優惠。指定日子晚上7時至11時，The Plaza有DJ現場打碟，1號蘭桂坊設化妝櫃柕。晚上8時至8時30分，怪物軍團會快閃蘭桂坊街道，進行短時間巡遊及表演。
活動與香港旅遊發展局的萬聖月跨區節目同期舉行。主辦方表示市民可穿上萬聖節服裝參與街頭活動。詳情及任何集卡安排可參閱協會網站。
公眾街道活動免費參與；個別餐廳的餐飲價錢由商戶自行釐定。
